messages:
incident-bot: Pager alert: P2 - model-warmup failure in cluster-us-west-2a (inference-runtime). Repeated OOMs during deserialization + compile timeouts. Links: https://internal.incidents/7812349999 :rotating_light:

alice_oncall: I'm on it. Which nodes are showing failures?

miguel_runtime: seeing GPU OOM on gpunode-12 and gpunode-14. Log snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T02:12:33Z] model_init: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-17T02:12:36Z] compile: nvrtc compilation timed out after 30s -> fallback triggered
```
Lots of `deser` failures during artifact unpack.

sara_ml: model is 30B fp16-q4 + new fused-attn kernel from last runtime build. Could be a regression in the kernel or increased memory pressure from warmup.

tom_support: two customers filed incidents: AcmeAnalytics (prod) and BrightShop (staging-prod). They're seeing 503s and increased latency. Customer impact ~= 3-4% of requests to the model.

alice_oncall: short mitigation idea: route critical traffic to model-small-8B for HA customers while we stabilize warmup. Can we update routing rules quickly?

james_enginfra: I can push a canary routing change. Need approval to apply to production canary.

emma_pagerduty: +1 approve, proceed.

james_enginfra: applied canary rule (10% traffic) for model-id:rr/large-2026 -> fallback to model-small-8B where customer_tag=="ha". API call: `POST /admin/routes` -> 200.

miguel_runtime: also toggling KVCACHE_PREFETCH=false on the nodes experiencing high warmup churn and restarting the agent on gpunode-12 to free stale allocations. Command: `kubectl -n runtime set env ds/inference-agent KVCACHE_PREFETCH=false && kubectl rollout restart ds/inference-agent -l node=gpunode-12`

alice_oncall: restart kicked off. Observability, can you watch warmup error rate and request failures?

miguel_runtime: early signals: deser_error_count on gpunode-12 down from 46/min -> 8/min after restart. Compile timeouts still appearing intermittently; enabling fallback to precompiled kernels for that model as well.

sara_ml: I'm rolling back the fused-attn change from yesterday's runtime build to the staging channel to validate if it reproduces. If rollback in staging is clean, we'll produce a safe build without the aggressive nvrtc flags.

tom_support: preparing status page update: "Mitigation in progress: fallback routing to smaller model for HA customers; reduced request success rate for heavy queries. Monitoring." Posting now.

alice_oncall: plan: monitor 20m. If error rate <1% and customer 503s drop, expand canary to 50% then 100%. If compile timeouts persist, we'll coordinate hotfix to disable nvrtc JIT for that kernel.

incident-bot: Incident state -> mitigation_in_progress; owner: alice_oncall.
